# TenantNotice.online - LLM Context Manifest
> Precision statutory tenant and landlord notice generation platform with strict jurisdictional segregation between the United States, the United Kingdom, and Canada.

## Core Jurisdictions
- [United States Tenancy Portal](https://tenantnotice.online/us/): State-specific statutory notice generators for California, Texas, Florida, and New York.
- [United Kingdom Tenancy Portal](https://tenantnotice.online/uk/): Parliamentary compliant notice builders reflecting the Renters' Rights Act.
- [Canada Tenancy Portal](https://tenantnotice.online/canada/): Provincial statutory notice and deposit interest calculation engines for Ontario (LTB), British Columbia (RTB), and Alberta (RTDRS).
- [Legal Blog Hub](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/): Authoritative statutory legal analyses and tenancy dispute guides for US, UK, and Canadian jurisdictions.

## US Statutory Notice Utilities
- [30-Day Notice to Vacate Generator](https://tenantnotice.online/us/30-day-notice-to-vacate.html): Governed by California Civ. Code Section 1946.1, Texas Prop. Code Section 24.005, Florida Stat. Section 83.57, New York RPL Section 226-c.
- [3-Day Notice to Pay Rent or Quit](https://tenantnotice.online/us/3-day-pay-rent-or-quit.html): Governed by California CCP Section 1161(2), Florida Stat. Section 83.56(3), Texas Prop. Code Section 24.005.
- [Security Deposit Demand Letter](https://tenantnotice.online/us/security-deposit-demand.html): Governed by California Civ. Code Section 1950.5 (21 days), Texas Prop. Code Section 92.103 (30 days), Florida Stat. Section 83.49 (15 to 60 days).
- [24-Hour Notice to Enter Premises](https://tenantnotice.online/us/24-hour-notice-to-enter.html): Governed by California Civ. Code Section 1954 and common law privacy covenants.

## UK Statutory Tenancy Utilities
- [Section 8 Notice to Quit Form 3](https://tenantnotice.online/uk/section-8-notice-to-quit.html): Governed by Housing Act 1988 reformed Schedule 2 possession grounds under the Renters' Rights Act.
- [Tenant Notice to Quit](https://tenantnotice.online/uk/tenant-notice-to-quit.html): Governed by Assured Periodic Tenancy termination rights under English common law and statute.
- [Tenancy Deposit Refund Demand](https://tenantnotice.online/uk/tenancy-deposit-demand.html): Governed by Housing Act 2004 Section 213 compliance and custodial schemes (DPS, TDS, MyDeposits).
- [Section 13 Rent Increase Challenge Form 4](https://tenantnotice.online/uk/section-13-rent-challenge.html): Governed by Housing Act 1988 Section 13 referral to the First-tier Tribunal (Property Chamber).

## Canada Statutory Tenancy Utilities
- [Ontario Form N9 60-Day Tenant Notice to End Tenancy](https://tenantnotice.online/canada/ontario-form-n9.html): Governed by Ontario Residential Tenancies Act 2006 Section 44, enforcing 60-day calendar alignment with the final day of a rental period and Section 44(4) February statutory exception rules.
- [British Columbia RTB 1-Month Tenant Notice to End Tenancy](https://tenantnotice.online/canada/bc-rtb-notice.html): Governed by British Columbia Residential Tenancy Act Section 45, enforcing full monthly rental calculation on the day preceding rent due dates and Section 90 deemed delivery rules.
- [Alberta Periodic Tenancy Notice to Terminate](https://tenantnotice.online/canada/alberta-periodic-notice.html): Governed by Alberta Residential Tenancies Act Sections 6 through 12, featuring dual-role execution (1 full rental month tenant notice and 3 full rental months landlord notice with mandatory Section 11 statutory cause).
- [Ontario Last Month Rent (LMR) Deposit Interest Calculator](https://tenantnotice.online/canada/ontario-lmr-interest.html): Governed by Ontario Residential Tenancies Act Section 106(6) and Section 106(7), computing annual statutory interest across official 2007 through 2026 rent increase guidelines with compound rent increase offset mechanics.

## Authoritative Statutory Blog Articles (US & UK)
- [California 30-Day vs 60-Day Notice Rules](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/california-30-day-vs-60-day-notice-to-vacate-rules.html): Statutory tenure benchmarks under Civil Code 1946.1 and Code of Civil Procedure Section 12 day counting rules.
- [California AB 1482 Just Cause Evictions & Rent Caps](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/california-ab-1482-tenant-protection-act-just-cause-evictions.html): Civil Code 1946.2 just cause requirements, mandatory relocation payments, and Section 1947.12 rent caps.
- [Texas Property Code 24.005 Notice to Vacate Procedure](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/texas-property-code-24-005-notice-to-vacate-procedure.html): 3-day notice rules, delivery affidavits, outside door posting restrictions, and Justice Court timelines.
- [Florida Statute 83.56 Three-Day Notice Rent Calculation](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/florida-statute-83-56-three-day-notice-rent-calculation.html): Mandatory exclusion of weekends and court holidays, rent definitions, and County Court dismissals.
- [Security Deposit Return Demand Letters: CA, TX, FL](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/security-deposit-return-demand-letters-california-texas-florida.html): Comparative statutory deadlines, wear and tear standards, and bad-faith punitive damages.
- [Renters' Rights Act Complete Guide: Section 21 Abolition](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/renters-rights-act-complete-guide-section-21-abolition.html): Abolition of Section 21 no-fault evictions and automatic conversion to rolling periodic tenancies.
- [Reformed Section 8 Form 3 Ground 8 Rent Arrears](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/reformed-section-8-notice-form-3-ground-8-rent-arrears.html): Mandatory 3-month rent arrears threshold, 4-week notice periods, and benefit delay defenses.
- [Ground 1A Landlord Intention to Sell Notice Rules](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/ground-1a-landlord-intention-to-sell-notice-rules.html): Mandatory 4-month notice period, initial 12-month tenancy protection buffer, and £40,000 penalties.
- [Tenant Statutory Notice to Quit Periodic Tenancy](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/tenant-statutory-notice-to-quit-periodic-tenancy.html): 2-month written notice rules, flexible expiry dates, and joint tenancy surrender effects.
- [Challenging Section 13 Rent Increases in First-tier Tribunal](https://tenantnotice.online/blog/challenging-section-13-rent-increases-first-tier-tribunal.html): Form 4 limitations, tribunal market rent determinations, and application deadlines.

## Authoritative Legal Guides
- [US Eviction Process and Statutory Timelines Guide](https://tenantnotice.online/guides/us-eviction-process-guide.html): Complete breakdown of notice windows, court filings, and service procedures.
- [UK Renters' Rights Act Comprehensive Guide](https://tenantnotice.online/guides/uk-renters-rights-act-guide.html): Guidance on Section 21 abolition, periodic tenancies, and possession grounds.
- [Security Deposit Return Rights Handbook](https://tenantnotice.online/guides/security-deposit-return-rights.html): Small claims court deposit recovery procedures for US and UK tenants.
